propositions: A one-time atomic force-with-lease rewrite of the tickets branch must be executed under operator-confirmed quiescence with all writers disabled and zero active sessions verified before publication.

Pre-publication correctness assertions must verify that the rewritten store tree hash is identical to the pre-rewrite tip, commit/merge counts unchanged, and old tip SHA is not an ancestor of any fetched ref in a fresh unfiltered clone.

The epoch-mismatch guard must be validated by direct runtime refusal probes using both the deployed review-bot runtime and the explicitly refreshed host binary against temporary real clones before any force-push occurs.

After publication, the deterministic first post-window write must be the rebar.toml identity.enforce_since re-pin landing through Gerrit, with old-tip ancestry remaining false and size-pack growth under 1 MB measured immediately post-rewrite.
Rollback to pre-A6-1 state is possible via the A6-0d bundle and force-with-lease back to the old tip, but re-diverges already converged consumers; forward path re-convergence order must be preserved.

Post-enable reconciliation must validate via either green reconcile-bridge.yml run or operator-approved signed CLI sequence with zero mutation/recovery failures, every Jira batch error=None, and canary drift_total=0; final rebar fsck must be clean.
